output_interpretation: Model Risk Score used for diabetes screening. The score is not a clinical diagnosis and should not be interpreted as a calibrated clinical probability of diabetes.
research_model_note: The original XGBoost Permutation-12 model is preserved separately as the primary research model.
deployment_revision_note: The alcohol feature was removed following post-hoc explainability, stratified association, counterfactual sensitivity and ablation analyses. The observed alcohol association must not be interpreted as evidence of a protective causal effect.
threshold_sensitivity_note: A lower threshold can achieve recall around 90%, but produces lower precision and specificity. The deployment threshold stored here is the OOF Best-F2 threshold.
